name: Wit of the Burning Wind
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area: 10-ft.-radius burst
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Each creature within the area of effect takes 2d6 points of fire damage +1 point per caster level . In addition, the target takes 5 points of fire damage each round. A successful Reflex save (DC determined by the spell) at the end of the target’s turn negates this additional damage.

For the duration of the encounter, you gain Darkvision up to 60 feet if you don’t already have it. If you already have darkvision, the range of your darkvision is doubled. This effect lasts until the end of combat.
